lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, forming a roughly rectangular grid pattern posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal spot rows, creating localized anchor nodes at the intersection points across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-intensity highlight on the dorsal edge and a low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of white, elongated, high-contrast structures is visible attached to the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin at the axil.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin contains a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
